en: ## Completion Requirements
- Meet the **required period of study** under Article 41 of the University Regulations (Master's 2 years, Ph.D. 2 years, Integrated M.S.–Ph.D. 3.5 years (from '25), 4 years (before '24))
- Earn the **credits required for completion** (Master's 24, Ph.D. 36, Integrated M.S.–Ph.D. 54 (from '25), 60 (before '24)) with a cumulative GPA of **3.0 (B°) or higher** across all courses
- Complete the designated prerequisite courses
- Complete the designated required courses
- International students: meet any additional criteria set at admission
- Complete the safety training for regular research personnel and obtain the certificate

※ (Students in extra semesters) Students who did not earn the required credits within the period of study must pay tuition based on the credits they register for: up to 3 credits, 1/2 of that semester's tuition; 4 credits or more, the full tuition for that semester

Ph.D. students in the Department of Applied Artificial Intelligence are deemed to have met the graduation requirements when they satisfy the following.

## How to upload

- SUIS System → Student Portal (right side) → SUIS System → Log in → Academic Affairs → Graduation → Thesis → Register_Thesis Research Plan → Enter the plan information (Korean title, English title) → Download the research plan form, fill it in and upload the file → Save (no department office submission)

- Submitting late can delay your degree conferral (without it you cannot register research output (a thesis submission requirement) or apply for the thesis review)
- The plan cannot be edited after submission. If a change is unavoidable, contact your graduate school office (General Graduate School: 02-970-6794)
※ To change the title, go to Academic Affairs > Graduation > Thesis > Register Thesis Title Change
## What the form contains
- Research title
- Researcher
- 1. Purpose and necessity of the research
- 2. Research content and methods (2-1, 2-2, 2-3 …)
- 3. Research schedule
- References

@Combined B.S.–M.S. program: Registered for 2 or more semesters and earned 15 or more credits
@Schedule: Apply in March or September; the exam is held in April or October
@Format: Oral exam
@Application: SUIS System → Graduation → Degree  Qualification Exam → Apply_Degree Qualification Exam
@ Thesis research plan: You must register your thesis research plan under Academic Affairs > Graduation > Thesis > Register_Thesis Research Plan

@ Photo registration: You cannot apply if your student record has no photo (SUIS System: Academic Affairs > Student Records > My Info > Photo Change Management - click ‘Search’ - click ‘New’ - click Attach Photo - view photo - Save)
## Master's Exam Exemption

Master's students are exempt if, during enrollment or the completion period, they present at least one paper at a domestic or international conference in their field, or publish one paper (regardless of author order) in a general international journal or a domestic professional journal (publication must be completed before the exam application date)
* Online publication counts; proof of publication required

en: @Who must submit: Ph.D. students who have submitted their thesis research plan and intend to have their thesis reviewed (master's students do not submit)
@Submission period: Late April (Spring), late October (Fall)
## What to submit (upload as one ZIP file)
- Research output report (Academic Affairs > Research Output > Research Output Report > Register research output)
- The published journal paper (the full text, clearly showing the journal name and publication information such as the year and issue)
## Criteria
### 1. Indexed Journals
- Journals indexed in SCIE, SSCI, A&HCI or SCOPUS in your field
※ Indexing is judged by the index list of the year before you submit your thesis review application
### 2. Indexed Language
- Only papers written in a language listed for that index (if the listed language is ‘ENG’, a paper written in Korean is not accepted)
※ The language requirement is judged by the index list of the year before you submit your thesis review application
### 3. Author Classification
- First author or corresponding author (your SEOULTECH affiliation must be stated)
### 4. Publication Date

- The paper must be published by the date you submit your thesis review application, or you must submit a certificate of scheduled publication (the scheduled issue, e.g. year and month, must be clearly stated)
## Notes
- Students in professional graduate schools and master's students do not submit
- You cannot submit research output without having submitted your thesis research plan
- (Ph.D.) Without research output you cannot apply for the thesis review
- Materials already submitted for a qualifying exam exemption cannot be reused
- (General Graduate School) Materials already submitted for the Future (Innovation) Talent Scholarship cannot be reused
- Your SEOULTECH affiliation must be stated on the research output

- ‘통합정보시스템 > 학사 > 졸업 > 논문 > 심사위원등록’에서 출력하여 날인
- 박사과정 심사위원은 반드시 2인 이상의 박사학위 소지자 포함 및 2인 이상의 다른 학과(또는 협동과정) 또는 교외의 전문가 포함
- 입금자 표기: 대학원명 앞 두 글자 + 학생명 (예시: 일반홍길동, 철도홍길동, 산업홍길동)
- ‘통합정보시스템 > 학사 > 졸업 > 논문 > 수료증 등록_연구윤리교육(KIRD)’에도 반드시 업로드
- 교내 ‘대학원생을 위한 연구윤리 비교과 프로그램’을 이수하였을 경우 제출 불요
- 미이수자는 학교 홈페이지 대학원 공지사항의 ‘논문제출자격 부여를 위한 연구윤리교육 의무 이수 안내’ 게시글 확인
- 일반대학원 공학, 이학계열 학생만 필수 제출
- 미이수자는 학교 홈페이지 대학원 공지사항의 ‘연구활동종사자 온라인 안전교육 안내’ 게시글 확인 (홈페이지 주소: dnsm.seoultech.ac.kr)
- 석·박사학위 청구논문 심사 결과서(서식 [붙임7] 참조): 심사위원장 작성
- 학위청구논문 표절검사보고서: 논문 심사 시 제출한 표절검사보고서와 동일
### 온라인 학위논문(최종본) 전자파일 제출 및 제출확인서 제출
- 도서관 학위논문서버(dCollectiion) 업로드 방법은 도서관 홈페이지 참조 (문의: 02-970-9045)
- 학위논문 온라인 제출확인서: 도서관 학위논문서버 → 업로드 → 출력
en: @Submission opens: May (Spring), November (Fall)
@Where to submit: Department office

@Eligibility: Students who meet the thesis submission requirements (course completion requirements met or expected to be met this semester, Degree Qualifying Exam passed, research output submitted, research ethics training completed)
## Thesis Submission Registration
### 1. Degree Thesis Review Application
- SUIS System > Academic Affairs > Graduation > Thesis > Print Thesis Review Application
### 2. Thesis Review Committee Recommendation Form
- Print from ‘SUIS System > Academic Affairs > Graduation > Thesis > Register Committee Members’ and stamp it
- Master's: 3 members / Ph.D.: 5 members
- Your advisor cannot serve as committee chair
- A Ph.D. committee must include at least 2 Ph.D. holders and at least 2 experts from another department (or interdisciplinary program) or from outside the university
- External members must submit the ‘Consent to Provide (Use) Personal Information’ form (see Form [Attachment 1])
### 3. Proof of Review Fee Payment
- Transfer receipt, account screenshot, etc.
- Master's: KRW 100,000 / Ph.D.: KRW 300,000
- Account: KB Kookmin Bank 073037-04-010919 (Seoul National University of Science and Technology)
- Depositor name: first two characters of your graduate school name + your name (e.g., 일반홍길동, 철도홍길동, 산업홍길동)
- Research Ethics Pledge (see Form [Attachment 2])
- Sign by hand and submit
### 4. Research Ethics Training Certificate (print and submit)
- Required for students admitted from the 2017 academic year ([Attachment 3])
- Also upload it to ‘SUIS System > Academic Affairs > Graduation > Thesis > Register Certificate_Research Ethics Training (KIRD)’
- Not required if you completed the on-campus ‘Research Ethics Extracurricular Program for Graduate Students’
- If not yet completed, see the Graduate School notice ‘Mandatory Research Ethics Training for Thesis Submission Eligibility’ on the university website
### 5. Safety Training Certificate for Regular Research Personnel
- Required only for engineering and natural science students in the General Graduate School
- If not yet completed, see the Graduate School notice ‘Online Safety Training for Research Personnel’ on the university website (site: dnsm.seoultech.ac.kr)
## Thesis Review & Result Report
@Thesis review: Conducted by each lab
### Submitting the Thesis Review Result Report
- Period: mid-June (Spring), mid-December (Fall)
- Where: Your department office
- Documents
- Master's/Ph.D. Degree Thesis Review Result Report (see Form [Attachment 7]): completed by the committee chair
- Plagiarism check report for the thesis: the same report submitted at the thesis review
### Online Submission of the Final Thesis File & Submission Confirmation
- Upload the final thesis file online: July (Spring), January (Fall)
- For how to upload to the library thesis server (dCollection), see the library website (Tel: 02-970-9045)
- Submit the online submission confirmation
- Online Thesis Submission Confirmation: Library thesis server → Upload → Print
- Where: Graduate School Office (Eoui-gwan Rm. 613)
